name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Existence(has_key) repeats what the other two clauses already force. Existence(at_goal) hard plus Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard already forces has_key, since at_goal cannot be reached without first has_key. Remove Existence(has_key); keep Existence(at_goal) and Precedence(has_key, at_goal).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) requires the goal and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) puts the key before it, which together also force picking up the key.

texts: pick up the key before reaching the goal
